ItemID: NA; Title: Home for Christmas; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Fits my past Christmas listening, but I would only pick one album today.
ItemID: NA; Title: Partners; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Nothing here clearly connects it to the music I have been choosing.
ItemID: NA; Title: That's Christmas To Me; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 5; REASON: Its vocal Christmas sound fits my holiday listening and interest in The New Old Fashioned; this would be my pick.
ItemID: NA; Title: Oscd Ad Adele 21; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for Adele's pop sound this time.
ItemID: NA; Title: The Silver Lining - The Songs of Jerome Kern; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A Jerome Kern song collection does not match what I want to hear right now.
ItemID: NA; Title: To Be Loved; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I do not see enough connection to my recent listening to try it today.
ItemID: NA; Title: In The Lonely Hour; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Its melancholy pop direction is not what I am seeking on this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Noel; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The Christmas theme interests me, but I would choose That's Christmas To Me first.
ItemID: NA; Title: Together; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: The title alone gives me too little reason to expect a good fit.
ItemID: NA; Title: Traveller; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I am not looking for a country album today.
